title: Devin Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Devin is a genuinely autonomous AI coding agent, but it falls short on hosting, needing an existing codebase, and its 2026 pricing overhaul. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform.
body_markdown: For a team with an existing codebase, Devin is genuinely strong at autonomous PR-level work. For anyone without a codebase yet who needs a hosted product, database, auth, payments, and a live URL, Blink is the better alternative: it generates the whole product from a description, no existing codebase, team, or infrastructure required.
